pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: A direct hit from any Projectile entity triggers teleportation and deals no damage. Native sleep blocks normal hits too. Use melee, turn toward its new position after a teleport, and avoid firing at the old location.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Chorus Crystal. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
